terra.problem: The text does not say nobody was left outside or describe anyone wondering about the noise.
The text does not say whether the people received copies to take home.
The verse records Josiah's command, but does not say the doorkeepers were hauling the articles out.
Saying Josiah didn't leave a corner out goes beyond the high places the verse describes.
Saying he is not going to joke comments on how he tells the passage.
Nobody was left to guard is an unclear comparison: the altars are things, not people.
Nothing was left standing goes beyond what the text says about the altar, high place and pole.
Not one thing was left behind goes beyond the text's account of what Josiah did to the altar, high place and pole.
Calling the man in the tomb a guest of honor makes an unclear joke about a serious scene.
The text describes bones burned on the altar at Bethel, not bones being burned all over Bethel.
